corrections.old_text: ፈራ ። ያም ሆነ ያም ሆነ ከግለ
corrections.corrected_text: ፈራ ። ያም ሆነ ያም ሆነ ከጣለ
corrections.reason: The three-legged character ጣ in ከጣለ (construct state 'from the shadow of [the Law]', ከጣለ ኦሪት) was misread as ግ due to tight spacing between the legs.
The initial character is 1st-order አ in አላመነም ('he did not believe'), misread as 6th-order እ.
